title: FriesTrader setup board
blurb: Hub-local tracker for FriesTrader setup through the go-live decision. Tasks only: no account numbers, balances, positions, dollar amounts or order data are ever recorded here.

items.title: Set up private project repo from upstream template
items.notes: Private copy created from YizhiSong/FriesTrader with the upstream remote added. Setup commit moved the conviction sizing table into risk_rules.json and added a Phase A rule to disallow place_*/cancel_* tools. execution.mode stays dry_run.

items.title: Open a Robinhood Agentic account
items.notes: Separate, dedicated Agentic account with a small budget reserved for the agent. Opened from a desktop during MCP authentication. Only Tongli can do this.

items.title: Connect the Robinhood Trading MCP
items.notes: Official MCP over OAuth (no passwords in the repo). Then fill the account placeholders, watchlist and scan in the private repo's risk_rules.json. Never on this hub.

items.title: Block order tools in Phase A
items.notes: Disallow every place_* and cancel_* tool in the Phase A session's permissions or connector config. Verify that a Phase A run cannot reach them.

items.title: Schedule Phase A and Phase B
items.notes: Phase A about 4:30pm CT and Phase B about 8:35am CT on weekdays. Only one scheduler per phase. Stays in dry_run.

items.title: Dry-run review (0 of 10 days; target 4–6 weeks)
items.notes: Read each cycle's log, especially rejections and stop triggers. Re-run the risk scripts by hand to spot-check the math. Post sanitized summaries to the dry-run log.

items.title: Go-live decision
items.notes: Only Tongli flips execution.mode to live, by hand, after the dry-run review. Start tiny and keep the loss limits.
